# Independent audit: freely variable simplex with fixed proper caps



I independently checked the exact cut-simplex formula and its coefficient
in each independent off-diagonal vertex variable. The coefficient is
-1+sum eta-eta_i+(1+k_j)eta_j as stated. For m>=3 its vanishing forces
all eta_i equal; the remaining equations then force all thresholds
equal and the displayed strictly positive objective-one multipliers.
The converse, concurrence condition and full-affine-space coverage
criterion all have the stated signs.

The explicit right inverse has zero column sums, trace sum f_i/h_i,
and exactly the requested normalized cap derivatives. The coefficient
of the cap-neutral objective derivative is J_ij from (8), including
its sign. Subtracting the right inverse and then adding the strictly
negative cap vector produces exactly trace J/2 and every cap
derivative -epsilon. Positivity of the strict cap chamber therefore
gives an actual simplex path, with no unstated feasibility assumption.

The d=1 exception is correct, as are the nonconcurrent equal-threshold
stationary covers. The claim excludes active compatibility constraints
and does not infer an improvement from failure of one arbitrarily
prescribed multiplier vector.

The supplied verifier was rerun with the math-venv Python runtime and
passed its 816 exact checks and the actual rational simplex witness.
No correction was found.
note: Mathematical discussion retained to expose corrections and limitations. This is not a verification run, accepted premise, or approval of the revised submission. Association follows explicit source-document references, not an inferred dependency.
